src.label: USDA APHIS — pet travel from the United States to Kuwait (relaying Kuwaiti rules)

head: Kuwait requires a rabies antibody test and bans a long list of dog breeds.
lines: The US agriculture department page on Kuwaiti entry says dogs, cats and ferrets need a rabies antibody (titer) test taken no less than 3 months and no more than 12 months before entering Kuwait, and a health certificate from an accredited vet endorsed by the US authority.

The page lists prohibited dog breeds, including Pit Bulls, Staffordshire and American Staffordshire Terriers, American Bully, all Mastiff types, Rottweilers, Doberman Pinschers, Caucasian Shepherds and Anatolian Shepherds, and any mix of them.
This is a US-side relay of Kuwaiti rules, so confirm with the Kuwaiti authority before travel.
